issues: src/lib/backup.ts is an empty file (0 bytes). The acceptance test __tests__/acceptance/m4.test.ts fails with `TypeError: (0 , _backup.createBackup) is not a function`, and tsc reports `error TS2305: Module '"../../src/lib/backup"' has no exported member 'createBackup'` / `'restoreBackup'`. Implement and export `createBackup(store, passphrase): Promise<string>` and `restoreBackup(store, blob, passphrase): Promise<void>` in src/lib/backup.ts: serialize all collections (receipts, mileage) plus settings and photo bytes, derive a key with `deriveKey` (scrypt, random salt) from src/lib/crypto.ts, encrypt with the AES-256-GCM `encrypt`, embed salt+version in the payload, and on restore validate the envelope, decrypt (throwing a friendly error on a wrong passphrase or damaged file), then `clearAll()` and re-put every record.

src/lib/storage/device.native.ts is an empty file (0 bytes), so tsc fails with `error TS2305: Module '"./device.native"' has no exported member 'createDeviceKeyProvider'` / `'createDeviceRawStore'` (src/lib/storage/device.ts:3). Implement the native raw store (expo-sqlite, current async API, storing ciphertext) and the key provider (32-byte key in expo-secure-store) so that the encrypted-at-rest requirement actually holds on iOS/Android; right now the device build has no storage backend at all.

src/screens/RestoreScreen.tsx:24 calls `restoreBackup(fileUri, passphrase)` with the wrong argument shape (no Store, and fileUri is never set because no file picker is wired up: `fileUri` stays `''`, so Restore always shows 'Enter passphrase.'). Add a 'Select backup file' button using expo-document-picker, read the file, and call the new `restoreBackup(getStore(), blob, passphrase)`. The designer's flow (ui_flow.json steps 'upload Select backup file', fill 'Backup passphrase', click 'Restore', expect 'Data restored successfully.') must work.

Static check 'screens use the theme' fails: src/screens/BackupSuccessScreen.tsx:10 hard-codes `style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '600' }}` on a bare react-native `Text`. Use Paper's `Text` with a theme variant (e.g. `variant="titleMedium"`) and theme colors, or the shared `Screen`/ui components, so no screen sets type or color by hand.

Static check 'ui primary flow' fails at step 61: after filling 'Backup passphrase'/'Confirm passphrase' and clicking 'Create backup' the text 'Backup ready to share' never appears (BackupPassphraseScreen.create() throws because `createBackup` is undefined, so it falls into the catch and shows 'Backup failed'); the flow also expects to land on a `backup_success` screen with a 'Restore from backup' button. Fix the backup implementation and navigate to BackupSuccessScreen (which is currently not registered in src/navigation/index.tsx) on success, and share the file via expo-sharing as the task requires.

Backup/restore does not currently cover photos, and the required share step is missing: src/lib/backupState.ts only keeps the blob in memory. The backup must be written to a file (expo-file-system) containing all records *and* the receipt photos, then shared through the share sheet (expo-sharing) so the user can save it to Files/iCloud/Drive. Note expo-file-system is used in src/lib/exportPdf.ts but is not declared in package.json dependencies - add it (and expo-sharing is declared but never used).

Estimated tax is hard-coded on the dashboard: src/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx renders `<SummaryCard label="Estimated tax" value="$0.00" />` instead of computing (income - expenses - mileage deduction) * taxRate clamped at >= 0 using the configurable rate from src/lib/settings.ts. Add the calculation to src/lib/finance.ts (never negative) and show it, with unit tests.
feedback: The app's shell, navigation, theme and the M1-M3 logic are in reasonable shape, but milestone 4 is essentially unimplemented: src/lib/backup.ts and src/lib/storage/device.native.ts are both empty files, which is the direct cause of the two failing acceptance tests, four of the six tsc errors, and the UI-flow failure at the 'Backup ready to share' step. Implement the passphrase-based backup/restore (scrypt + AES-GCM from src/lib/crypto.ts, integrity check, friendly wrong-passphrase/damaged-file errors, photos included, written to a file and shared via expo-sharing) and the native SQLite + SecureStore backend, wire RestoreScreen to a real document picker with the correct `restoreBackup(store, blob, passphrase)` signature, register/route BackupSuccessScreen, replace the hard-coded `fontSize` in BackupSuccessScreen with theme typography, and compute the estimated tax on the dashboard from the configurable tax rate (clamped at zero). Add unit tests for the new backup round-trip and tax calculation.
